program:
app "Tape ball" ball mint
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool, out bool
let legal = count(ball where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs all) + count(ball where wide = yes)
runs "/" count(ball where out = yes) big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) "." legal % 6 "of 6" faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 1
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes
if legal >= 36
  "Innings over" head color warn
button "New match" tap remove all ball
describe:
Tape ball, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- ball: runs: number, 0 to 6, starts at 0; wide: yes or no; out: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- legal is how many ball entries where wide is no.
- runs is the total runs of ball plus how many ball entries where wide is yes.
Shows:
- text: runs, "/", how many ball entries where out is yes.
- text: "Overs", legal divided by 6 rounded down, ".", legal leaves over when divided by 6, "of 6".
- for 0, 1, 2, 4, 6:
  - a button the value; a tap adds a ball with runs set to the value.
- a button "Wide"; a tap adds a ball with wide set to yes.
- a button "Out"; a tap adds a ball with out set to yes.
- if legal is at least 36:
  - text: "Innings over".
- a button "New match"; a tap removes all ball entries, with one undo.

app "Sleep" moon mint
table night slept time, woke time, quality num 1..5 = 3
setting need dur = 8h "Sleep goal"
let avg7 = sum(night last 7 days, (it.woke - it.slept)) / count(night last 7 days)
"Average sleep, last 7 nights" faint
avg7 big color if(avg7 >= need, good, warn)
daybars last 7 days, sum(night on it, (it.woke - it.slept) / 1h)
"Average quality" round(avg(night.quality last 7 days)) "of 5" faint
remind "Time to wind down" at 22:30
form night
list night by day
describe:
Sleep, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- night: slept: time of day; woke: time of day; quality: number, 1 to 5, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Sleep goal": length of time, starts at 8 hours.
Works out:
- avg7 is the sum of the result of its woke minus its slept over the night in the last 7 days divided by how many night entries in the last 7 days.
Shows:
- text: "Average sleep, last 7 nights".
- text: avg7.
- a bar chart of the sum of the result of its woke minus its slept divided by 1 hour over the night on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- text: "Average quality", the average quality of night in the last 7 days rounded, "of 5".
- a form to add a night.
- a list of night by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "Time to wind down" at 22:30 every day.

let n = count(care)
count(care_done today) "of" n "done today" head
each care
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
    toggle it.care_done
form care
describe:
Skincare, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- care: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- care done: care: a care. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- n is how many care entries.
Shows:
- text: how many care done entries today, "of", n, "done today".
- for each care:
  - a group; a tap opens the care for editing; a swipe removes the care, with undo:
    - text: its name.
    - a tick box for its care done.
- a form to add a care.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Milk yield" milk mint
table milking litres num 0.5..60 unit "L"
stat round(avg(milking.litres last 30 days)), "average entry, last 30 days"
form milking
list milking by day
remind "Time to log milk from my buffalo" at 7:30
describe:
Milk yield, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- milking: litres: number, 0.5 to 60, in L. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a big number: the average litres of milking in the last 30 days rounded, labelled "average entry, last 30 days".
- a form to add a milking.
- a list of milking by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "Time to log milk from my buffalo" at 7:30 every day.
hurried_style: lowercase with one or two typos, 3 to 10 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first

program:
app "Weight" scale mint
table weigh kg num 20..300 unit "kg"
setting target num = 65 "Target (kg)"
row gap 3
  stat last(weigh.kg), "kg now"
  stat abs(round((last(weigh.kg) - target) * 10) / 10), "kg from target"
trend weigh last 90 days sort at, it.kg
form weigh
list weigh
describe:
Weight, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- weigh: kg: number, 20 to 300, in kg. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Target (kg)": number, starts at 65.
Shows:
- a big number: the latest kg of weigh, labelled "kg now".
- a big number: the result of the latest kg of weigh minus target times 10 rounded divided by 10 without its sign, labelled "kg from target".
- a line chart of its kg over weigh in the last 90 days sorted by at.
- a form to add a weigh.
- a list of weigh; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: a sentence then a list of what is wanted, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Mock tests" target slate
table test name text, score num 0.., total num 1.. = 100
"Best" max(test.score) big
"Latest" last(test.score) "/" last(test.total) faint
"Average" round(sum(test.score) * 100 / max(sum(test.total), 1)) "%" faint
trend test, it.score * 100 / it.total
form test, "Add test"
list test
describe:
Mock tests, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- test: name: text; score: number, at least 0; total: number, at least 1, starts at 100. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Best", the highest score of test.
- text: "Latest", the latest score of test, "/", the latest total of test.
- text: "Average", the total score of test times 100 divided by the larger of the total total of test and 1 rounded, "%".
- a line chart of its score times 100 divided by its total over test.
- a form to add a test.
- a list of test; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: terse like a search query, 2 to 6 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Contacts" user slate
table contact name text, phone text, role text?, memo text?
screen main "Add" plus
  stat count(contact month), "this month"
  form contact
screen charts "Charts" chart
  daybars last 7 days, count(contact on it)
  list contact
remind "Time to add important contacts" at 22:00
describe:
Contacts, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- contact: name: text; phone: text; role: text, optional; memo: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a screen "Add":
  - a big number: how many contact entries this month, labelled "this month".
  - a form to add a contact.
- a screen "Charts":
  - a bar chart of how many contact entries on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
  - a list of contact; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "Time to add important contacts" at 22:00 every day.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one
